answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of proximity via Bluetooth beacon, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 429 identities means 429 fresh proofs and 51051 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. What carries the beacon here is verification, the sparrow of cost is what stops the farm, and the jade of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
